page.overview:
Who is Poppy?

Poppy is a character appearing in Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet. She is an Elite Four member of the Paldea region, specializing in types.

Poppy is a short and small girl with black and yellow hair and eyes. She wears a blue bonnet with a matching jacket and dress, yellow pantyhose, blue shoes and black gloves. She also wears a necklace with a key on it and has blush stickers on her cheeks, symbolizing her happy personality. The Steel locket and the metallic silver coloring of her clothing reflects her Steel-type preference.

Poppy is very young, cheery, and naive, reflecting her young age (she claims to be nine years old). She resembles the "Kindergartener" Trainer class in her mannerisms, often struggling to find the correct words and pronouncing them; she even mistakes "revenge" as "avenge", though this does not stop her from trying to address others in a polite and fluid manner. She also has a habit of nicknaming her Pokémon. She looks up to fellow Paldea Elite Four member Rika like a big sister, seeing her as a mentor and frequently asking her for advice when possible.

Though modest in her appearance (and sometimes expressing annoyance at her own age), she does show a lot of confidence in her training and expert skills, confidently recognizing the defensive nature of Steel types and when she laments that very few Trainers manage to defeat her.
